channel.title: Alberto Monge Roffarello
channel.description: Personal website of Alberto Monge Roffarello, Associate Professor at Politecnico di Torino

item.title: Participation in the European Commission's Special Panel on Child Safety Online
item.description: I took part in the final session of the European Commission's Special Panel on child safety online, contributing recommendations on digital wellbeing and platform design.

item.title: Promoted to Associate Professor
item.description: On July 16, 2026, I was promoted to Associate Professor at Politecnico di Torino.

item.title: Presentation at CHI 2026: "What is Digital Wellbeing?" — Honorable Mention
item.description: I presented our Honorable Mention paper "What is Digital Wellbeing? A Leverage Points Framework to Guide Research and Action" at CHI 2026 in Barcelona!

item.title: CHI 2026 Workshop: "Bridge Over Troubled Water" — Deceptive Design, Ethics, and Commercial Incentives
item.description: We held our CHI 2026 long workshop in Barcelona on deceptive design and ethical practice; I helped organise the event as part of the workshop team.

item.title: Presentation at CHI 2026: "The Digital Attention Heuristics" (TOCHI paper)
item.description: I presented our TOCHI paper on the Digital Attention Heuristics at CHI 2026 in Barcelona, Spain!

item.title: Two Honorable Mentions at CHI 2026
item.description: I received two Honorable Mention Awards at CHI 2026 for two papers on digital wellbeing and online communication.

item.title: Participation at ECAT Research Workshop 2025: Panel on Social Media Addiction and Digital Wellbeing
item.description: I participated as a panellist in the ECAT Research Workshop 2025 in Seville, discussing social media addiction and the features that make it hard for children to leave online platforms.

item.title: Participation at IS-EUD 2025: Two Papers on Digital Self-Control Tools and End-User Development
item.description: I'm presenting two papers at IS-EUD 2025 in Munich, Germany, both focusing on empowering end users to design their own digital self-control tools!

item.title: Participation at CHI 2025: Three Papers on AI Writing and Digital Wellbeing
item.description: Three papers I co-authored will be presented at CHI 2025 in Yokohama, Japan, covering AI-assisted writing and digital wellbeing research!

item.title: New TOCHI paper: "The Digital Attention Heuristics: Supporting the User's Attention by Design"
item.description: Our paper on digital attention heuristics has been published in ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction (TOCHI)!

item.title: New Entertainment Computing paper: "Supporting Teachers, Engaging Students: A Collaborative Model for K-12 Computing Education"
item.description: Our paper on collaborative K-12 computing education has been published in Entertainment Computing journal!

item.title: New CHI 2023 paper: "Defining and Identifying Attention Capture Damaging Patterns in Digital Interfaces"
item.description: Our paper on attention capture damaging patterns has been accepted to CHI 2023!

item.title: New TOCHI paper: "Achieving Digital Wellbeing Through Digital Self-Control Tools: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis"
item.description: Our paper on digital self-control tools has been accepted to ACM Transactions on Computer-Human Interaction (TOCHI)!

item.title: Special Issue: Understanding Digital Wellbeing Within Complex Technological Contexts
item.description: I'm co-editing a special issue on digital wellbeing in complex technological contexts!

item.title: New XRDS paper: "Designing Technology That Promotes Users' Digital Wellbeing"
item.description: Our paper on designing for digital wellbeing has been published in XRDS!

item.title: New TiiS paper: "Understanding, Discovering, and Mitigating Habitual Smartphone Use in Young Adults"
item.description: Our paper on smartphone habits has been accepted to ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems (TiiS)!

item.title: New CHI 2021 paper: "Coping with Digital Wellbeing in a Multi-Device World"
item.description: Our paper on multi-device digital wellbeing has been accepted to CHI 2021!

item.title: New TOIS paper: "From Users' Intentions to IF-THEN Rules in the Internet of Things"
item.description: Our paper on IoT rule generation has been accepted to TOIS!

item.title: PhD Defense
item.description: I successfully defended my PhD thesis on End-User Development in the Internet of Things!

item.title: New CHI 2019 paper: "Empowering End Users in Debugging Trigger-Action Rules"
item.description: Our paper on end-user debugging has been accepted to CHI 2019!

item.title: New CHI 2019 paper: "The Race Towards Digital Wellbeing: Issues and Opportunities"
item.description: Our paper on digital wellbeing has been accepted to CHI 2019!
